root_cause: The subtest deepEqual'd the whole profileStaleness entry before/after a plain updateProfile. Since 8b596c818 the entry carries `edited` + `updatedAt`, which a plain edit legitimately moves (updated_at = now > lineage_stamped_at). It only passed when saveProfile and updateProfile landed in the same millisecond, which is the usual case solo but not under full-suite load. The rebuild half was also skipped by an if-guard whenever the two analyses shared a millisecond.
fix: Pin every compared timestamp to distinct past values via direct UPDATEs (same pattern as the file's count-before-run test); assert lineage fields (newerSlug/newerAnalyzedAt) unchanged, assert edited flips to true and updatedAt names the new updated_at, run the rebuild half unconditionally.

proof.after: file passes 6/6; 20/20 loop runs green (5 rounds x 4 concurrent)
